analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Live, public analytics for this site, built from scratch, cookieless, and private by construction.
analytics.lead: Every number below comes from a first-party tracker, a Postgres events table, and a Redis cache, all built for this site. Public on purpose: measuring is part of the product.
analytics.topSectionsSummary: Total time visitors spent with each homepage section on screen.
analytics.scrollDepthSummary: How far down the homepage visitors scroll.
analytics.clickMapSummary: Where visitors click on the homepage, overlaid on a snapshot.
analytics.emptyState: No data yet. This dashboard fills up as people visit.
analytics.sparklineSummary: Daily pageviews across the whole site.
analytics.privacyHeading: What I measure, and what I don't
privacyMeasure: Pageviews, sections viewed, scroll depth, and clicks, aggregated
Device class, OS, browser, and country (from a request header, never the IP)
Anonymous per-tab session ids that rotate and expire on their own
privacyNot: No cookies, no fingerprinting, no cross-site anything
No names, emails, or any personal data: there is nowhere to store them
No raw IP addresses: the schema has no column for one
Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honored: tracking simply never starts
